downloaded_asset_scope: Partial official MAP-KG gene_projector and smiles_projector storages plus original ESM vectors; no full MAP runtime or RNA response model.
asset_authentication: Official pinned ESM revision and current public MAP Drive file ID; exact range byte counts, member ZIP CRC32 and local SHA256. No verification of the full checkpoint/ESM SHA256 from partial downloads. Reconstruct old knowledge1024 cache from original molecule256 and extracted smiles projector before scoring.
scoring_scope: Unconditioned shared-space cosine query, not the complete relation-conditioned MAP pretraining objective, novel-edge generalization or biological target engagement.
identity_rule: Full canonical isomeric SMILES and PubChem CID; use existing strict source-qualified identities. Deduplicate identical (CID,SMILES), exclude any structural neighbor sharing CID or full SMILES with the query. Preserve missing/ambiguous coverage for the full 146-candidate menu.
protein_rule: One exact ESM symbol per stable gene ID and one stable gene ID per symbol, exact original ESM lookup entry. Duplicate identical rows collapse; all ambiguous mappings remain recorded. No fuzzy or isoform reconstruction.
protein_gallery: All resolvable menu known-edge target genes plus exactly 1000 sampled symbols from the full eligible global gene-node set, excluding target symbols; stable sorted population, NumPy default_rng seed 20261009, sample without replacement. Target-enriched gallery, not genome-wide retrieval.
queries: All unique strict-qualified molecular identities with >=1 known drug-gene assertion in the full menu, fixed before scoring. Report 146 menu candidates, all encodable candidates, all unique identities, all known-assertion query identities and all unresolved target IDs. Do not replace denominators post hoc.
truth: Exact stable gene IDs present in source assertions; unknown/missing graph edges remain unknown. Original relation and row lineage retained. No edge heldout was imposed on pretrained assets.

control_definitions.protein_shuffle: One fixed permutation of full protein gallery rows, RNG seed 20261010; preserve actual truth and gene labels.
control_definitions.identity_permutation: One fixed permutation of all encodable deduplicated molecule identities, RNG seed 20261011; preserve actual query truth.
control_definitions.molecule_votes: Top-five other molecule identities by original molecule256 cosine, stable identity-order ties; score each gene by fraction of those five neighbors with a raw known assertion to that gene. Unknown neighbor annotations contribute no assertion; do not call them biological negatives.
control_definitions.popularity: Count known assertions to each gene across all other unique source-qualified gallery identities; leave out the query identity and any shared-CID/shared-SMILES variants. No query truth is used to compute its score.
control_definitions.dimension_rule: No cosine between incompatible molecule256 and protein5120 dimensions, no random projection baseline, no fitted mapping.

metrics.denominators: Primary includes every fixed known-assertion query identity. Recall uses all raw known target IDs, including explicitly documented unavailable/ambiguous targets. Queries without any gallery-resolvable truth have hit/recall/MRR=0 for this assay and remain flagged as unassessable biology. Also report a descriptive eligible-truth-only view without changing the primary denominator.
metrics.ties: Descending score, stable ascending gene stable ID; molecule neighbors descending cosine then stable (CID,SMILES).
metrics.uncertainty: Descriptive paired counts and per-query scores; no independent biological significance or policy gain is inferred.

acceptance: All partial storages and cache compatibility must pass. A content-retrieval advantage is observed only if primary knowledge hit@5 strictly exceeds both molecular target-vote and query-excluded popularity controls; report shuffled/identity nulls and secondary metrics without threshold tuning. Any failure or mixed result remains a negative/mixed content audit. No runtime promotion.
limitations: Known graph assertions may have appeared in knowledge pretraining.
Gallery intentionally includes all available menu targets and a fixed distractor subset.
Exact symbol lookup is not an independently authenticated protein-sequence/isoform lineage.
Unconditioned cosine does not supply direction, affinity, potency, dose/time dependence, RNA response, efficacy, safety or EVSI.
No new RNA or functional outcomes are accessed.
native_MAP_blockers: Original epoch_3 PrimeKG_ver1 forward semantics are absent from inspected public history.
Exact ordered 2000-output HVG map and decoder target scale remain missing.
Prior checkpoint-compatible current-code bridge showed causal first-CLS drug invariance and dose invariance; changing masks is a new model, not authenticated reproduction.
Full checkpoint/source restoration alone cannot resolve these semantic blockers.
